title: Excellent Floating Shelves though a Few Quality Control Issues
text:
Excellent Floating Shelves though a Few Quality Control Issues. After moving into our new house last summer I decided to rethink how I wanted to hook up all of the TVs. Due to the fact we moved away from having cable boxes we really didn’t need anything visible so I utilized these shelves in several locations to hold our steaming devices behind the TV next to the TV’s mount.

There are four sized shelves in this set and I’ve ended up using all of them.

I tested the weight capacity of the shelves in multiple ways prior to installation finding they were more than capable of supporting the devices I planned to place on them. Installation was straightforward and these shelves have held my entertainment devices without issue.

These shelves have worked perfectly for my uses but I will point out that 2 of the 4 shelves appear to have far better application of the Carbonized Black over them than the other 2 - it appears the stain was slopped on and allowed to dry without being wiped away. This is sloppy and an example of poor quality control. For my use where the shelves are hung high and behind a TV it was OK but I would not want that visible. If I was going to use these in any where they were going to be visible I would either be forced to return them or refinish.

Due to this lack of quality control I must give these shelves a 3 star review though without the poor finish they would definitely be 5 star product.
